title: Dutch Oven Dairy-Free Mississippi Pot Roast
ingredients: DIY Herb & Spice Blend: 1 tbsp dried parsley
3.5 lbs (approx. 1.6 kg) beef chuck roast, patted dry
1 tbsp high-heat cooking oil (e.g., olive or avocado oil) for searing
1 packet (1 oz / 28 g) au jus gravy mix (verify brand is milk-free)
1/2 cup (115 g / 1 stick) dairy-free stick butter (e.g., Earth Balance or Miyoko's), sliced
1/2 cup low-sodium beef broth or water (prevents scorching during Dutch oven braising)
instructions: Preheat & prepare: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C). Mix the DIY Herb & Spice Blend in a small bowl and set aside.
Sear the beef: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a heavy 5-to-7-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the roast 3 to 4 minutes per side until a deep golden-brown crust forms. Remove the pot from the heat.

Assemble: Sprinkle the DIY Herb Blend and the au jus gravy packet evenly over the top of the roast. Place the dairy-free butter slices evenly across the top of the seasoned beef. Scatter the pepperoncini peppers around the pot and pour in the pepperoncini brine. Carefully pour 1/2 cup beef broth down the inside edge of the pot, avoiding rinsing the seasonings off the top of the roast.
Bake low & slow: Cover tightly with the heavy Dutch oven lid and transfer to the preheated oven. Bake 3 to 3.5 hours, until the beef is fork-tender and pulls apart effortlessly.
Shred & serve: Remove from the oven. Shred the roast with two forks directly in the Dutch oven, stirring the meat thoroughly into the rich, bubbling pan jus.
notes: Serving = ~6 oz (~170 g) cooked meat with sauce. Nutrition is an estimate per serving, based on 8 servings, a 3.5 lb beef chuck roast and plant-based butter sticks. Cook time is 3 to 3.5 hours.
